exercise.name: Cross-Body Cable Extension
library_steps: Set a pulley at shoulder height and hold it with your far hand.
Start with your hand by the opposite shoulder, elbow bent.
Straighten your arm out to the side, return slowly, then switch arms.
exercise.one_line_summary: Standing side-on to a shoulder-height pulley, the far hand holds the D-handle by the opposite shoulder with the elbow bent ~125 deg; the upper arm stays at shoulder height while the elbow straightens and the hand moves out to the side. Triceps does the work.

setup.target: Shoulder height, on the other side of the body.
Fixed at shoulder height, a little forward of the side line.
setup.why: Library step; the elbow is the only joint that moves.

muscles.emg: All three heads active in the cable push-down (S2); all heads grew after cable elbow extensions (S1).
muscles.role: Straightens the elbow; what the exercise is for.
Holds the upper arm up and back.

mistakes.what_it_looks_like: The arm swings back with the hand.
mistakes.why_it_matters: Turns it into a reverse fly.

sources.citation: Maeo S, Wu Y, Huang M, et al. 2023. Triceps brachii hypertrophy is substantially greater after elbow extension training performed in the overhead versus neutral arm position. Eur J Sport Sci 23(7):1240-1250.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable-machine elbow extensions (90-0 deg) with the arm overhead vs by the side (neutral, pushdown-like), 12 weeks: all three triceps heads grew in both; the long head grew ~1.5x more overhead.

sources.citation: Hussain J, Sundaraj K, Subramaniam ID, Lam CK. 2020. Muscle fatigue in the three heads of triceps brachii during intensity and speed variations of triceps push-down exercise. Front Physiol 11:112.
sources.what_it_gave: Cable triceps push-down to failure, sEMG of the long, lateral and medial heads: all three heads work and fatigue at comparable rates.

clip_check.check: Start: hand near the opposite shoulder, elbow ~125
End: arm straight out to the side
Upper arm at the same place in both pictures
Fist closed on the handle; cable clear of the chest
